hero_kpi_rationale: The number of Monthly Transacting Users (MTUs) is a key indicator of platform activity and growth at Coinbase, reflecting user engagement and revenue potential
company_description: Coinbase Global, Inc. operates platform for crypto assets in the United States and internationally. It provides the primary financial account in the crypto economy for consumers; a brokerage platform with a pool of liquidity across the crypto marketplace for institutions; and a suite of products granting access to build onchain for developers. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in New York, New York.

kpis.name: Monthly Transacting Users
kpis.explanation: Number of users who conduct transactions on the platform at least once per month (28-day rolling period)
kpis.description: Indicator of platform engagement and growth. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data available for the past 5 years.

kpis.name: Assets on Platform
kpis.explanation: Total value of crypto-assets and stablecoins held or managed on behalf of clients in the platform's digital wallets
kpis.description: Indicator of client trust and monetization opportunity
kpis.signal: Trend in value of assets held

kpis.name: Trading Volume
kpis.explanation: Total US dollar value of spot transactions executed on the platform, including half of the value of off-platform routed trades
kpis.description: Indicator of trading activity and platform liquidity

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total platform revenue including transaction revenue and subscription and services revenue
kpis.description: Indicator of overall financial performance of the platform

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, adjusted to exclude certain non-recurring items
kpis.description: Indicator of operational performance and cash generation

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 29.67 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 7.83 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.

kpis.name: USDC Market Capitalization
kpis.explanation: Total value of USDC held in Coinbase products, reflecting stablecoin adoption
kpis.description: Indicator of USDC stablecoin adoption and payments strategy
